description: Wave 0 adversarial English pass over the 236 keys wave0_keyset.php --new-and-changed leaves for review (407 in scope, 171 already ruled by Tom). Each was read in its call-site context where the string alone was unclear and asked for every reading a careful non-native translator could take. 23 entries filed, all open with a PROPOSED rewrite (nothing written to lib/lang.ec.en.php). The other keys read one way only.

entries.complaint: "a vertex lives on exactly one pipe": "lives" is the everyday verb for residing, and a translator renders it that way or as "exists".
readings: a vertex belongs to one pipe as one of its bends
a vertex resides (lives) on a pipe, as a person lives in a house
entries.resolution: English rewritten as proposed (orchestrator, 2026-11-01). {id} was not morphed into a vertex: it joins {n} pipes, and a vertex belongs to exactly one pipe, so a junction must join exactly two.

entries.complaint: "a vertex lives only on a pipe": same everyday-verb "lives".
readings: a vertex can be only a bend of a pipe
a vertex resides on a pipe
entries.resolution: English rewritten as proposed (orchestrator, 2026-11-01). {id} was not morphed into a vertex: a pump or a valve is connected to it, and a vertex can be only a bend of a pipe.

entries.complaint: "it has its own elevation, tag, description or other data": "its own" reads as possession (it owns) or as a contrast with some shared value; "Clear it first" has no clear referent (the junction, or the data).
readings: it has an elevation, tag or description of its own that differs from a default
it has elevation, tag, description or other data entered, which must be cleared
entries.resolution: English rewritten as proposed (orchestrator, 2026-11-01). {id} was not morphed into a vertex: it has an elevation, tag, description or other data, and a vertex has none. Clear that data first.

entries.complaint: "so clear or edits change them too": "clear" parses as an adjective (transparent, plain) beside "edits" as a noun.
readings: clearing the override, or editing it, changes the others too
"clear" as an adjective: a clear or edits (changes) change them
entries.resolution: English rewritten as proposed (orchestrator, 2026-11-01). This override is stored in alternative "{alternative}", also used by {list}, so clearing it or editing it changes them too.

entries.complaint: "each one controlling at the solved state": "controlling" can mean exerting control (regulating, EPANET Active) or being a control (a [CONTROLS] rule); "the solved state" is not a defined term.
readings: each valve is regulating (active) in the solution
each valve is acting as a control rule or being controlled
entries.resolution: English rewritten as proposed (orchestrator, 2026-11-01). each valve regulating in the solution.

entries.complaint: "A fire hydrant junction passes 95 L/s with 14 m of residual pressure": "passes" reads as passes a test (meets a requirement) or as flows through.
readings: the junction delivers that flow while holding that residual pressure
the junction passes a fire flow test at that flow and pressure
entries.resolution: English rewritten as proposed (orchestrator, 2026-11-01). A fire hydrant junction delivers 95 L/s with 14 m of residual pressure.

entries.complaint: "A fire hydrant junction passes 1,500 gpm with 20 psi of residual pressure": "passes" reads as passes a test (meets a requirement) or as flows through.
readings: the junction delivers that flow while holding that residual pressure
the junction passes a fire flow test at that flow and pressure
entries.resolution: English rewritten as proposed (orchestrator, 2026-11-01). A fire hydrant junction delivers 1,500 gpm with 20 psi of residual pressure.

entries.complaint: "A fire hydrant junction passes 32 L/s with 14 m of residual pressure": "passes" reads as passes a test (meets a requirement) or as flows through.
readings: the junction delivers that flow while holding that residual pressure
the junction passes a fire flow test at that flow and pressure
entries.resolution: English rewritten as proposed (orchestrator, 2026-11-01). A fire hydrant junction delivers 32 L/s with 14 m of residual pressure.

entries.complaint: "A fire hydrant junction passes 500 gpm with 20 psi of residual pressure": "passes" reads as passes a test (meets a requirement) or as flows through.
readings: the junction delivers that flow while holding that residual pressure
the junction passes a fire flow test at that flow and pressure
entries.resolution: English rewritten as proposed (orchestrator, 2026-11-01). A fire hydrant junction delivers 500 gpm with 20 psi of residual pressure.

entries.complaint: "Buffer": a translator renders it as a GIS buffer polygon, a memory buffer, or a shock absorber, and the unit "× median pipe length" does not settle which.
readings: a margin of ground added around the network's extent, in median pipe lengths
a GIS buffer zone around each pipe
entries.resolution: "Buffer" is the GIS industry term for this margin (conventional wording rule); the label carries its unit, and the payload context gives the tip.

entries.complaint: "ROUGHNESS is stated in the terms of that formula": "terms" reads as wording, conditions, or the units and meaning of a formula.
readings: the ROUGHNESS value is on the scale of that formula's coefficient
ROUGHNESS is worded or described using that formula
entries.resolution: English rewritten as proposed (orchestrator, 2026-11-01). Head loss formula: {formula} ({code}). ROUGHNESS is the roughness coefficient of that formula.

entries.complaint: "Press Calculate": "press" is the keyboard/hardware sense; Calculate is a button, which Tom's word call says is clicked.
readings: press a keyboard key named Calculate
click the Calculate button
entries.resolution: English rewritten as proposed (orchestrator, 2026-11-01). The full report lists every node and every link at every reporting time step. Click Calculate, then open Water, Reports, Full.

entries.complaint: "Press the Run button" and "Press the Find button": buttons are clicked, and "press" reads as a keyboard action.
readings: press a key
click a button
entries.resolution: English rewritten as proposed (orchestrator, 2026-11-01). Replace both "Press" with "Click" (Click the Run button ... Click the Find button ...).

entries.complaint: "A blank cell is a column that quantity does not have": says a cell is a column, and "that quantity" has no antecedent.
readings: a blank cell means the column's quantity does not apply to that node or link
a blank cell is itself a column the quantity lacks
entries.resolution: English rewritten as proposed (orchestrator, 2026-11-01). A cell is blank where the node or link has no such quantity.

entries.complaint: "Back" alone: a translator may take it as the rear/body part, or as returning to the previous page rather than the previous menu level.
readings: return to the previous menu level
go back in browser history, or the rear side
entries.resolution: "Back" on a phone menu is the standard UI word every locale already has; the row is narrow, and key_context names the call site.

entries.complaint: "Draw" beside a checkbox: the verb reads as an instruction to draw (create) something; it means display the layer on the map. Tom's word call: a single checkbox says Check/Show, not an action verb.
readings: show this layer on the map
draw (create) a layer by hand
entries.resolution: English rewritten as proposed (orchestrator, 2026-11-01). Show

entries.complaint: "Reading the file" as a heading above a list of import notes: reads as instructions for how to read the file, or as the act of reading in progress.
readings: notes about what was read from the file
how to read the file (instructions)
entries.resolution: English rewritten as proposed (orchestrator, 2026-11-01). Import notes

entries.complaint: "How many others": others of what is not stated (junctions, pipes, steps).
readings: other junctions that also fall below the limit
other pipes or steps
entries.resolution: Tom chose "How many others" himself (2026-11-01); kept.

entries.complaint: "tucks back into its tab", "A tucked box": idiom; a translator renders it literally (folded, hidden away) and may conclude the box is closed.
readings: the box collapses to its tab and is still open
the box is put away/closed
entries.resolution: English rewritten as proposed (orchestrator, 2026-11-01). Replace "tucks back into its tab" with "collapses to its tab", "A tucked box" with "A collapsed box", "brings it out of its tab" with "expands it from its tab".

entries.complaint: "it flies out over the map": idiom for a flyout panel, read literally as flying.
readings: the box opens as a panel over the map
the box flies/moves out
entries.resolution: English rewritten as proposed (orchestrator, 2026-11-01). At 640 px or narrower, a docked box is always an auto-hide tab, and it opens as a panel over the map.

entries.complaint: "Bands, which paints each class flat": "flat" reads as level, smooth-surfaced or dull, not one solid color.
readings: each class is painted in one solid color
each class is painted level/without relief
entries.resolution: English rewritten as proposed (orchestrator, 2026-11-01). Bands, which paints each class in one solid color

entries.complaint: "so the node cannot be told": "told" is an idiom (distinguished) that reads as informed.
readings: it cannot be determined which of the two nodes the link ends at
the node cannot be informed/instructed
entries.resolution: English rewritten as proposed (orchestrator, 2026-11-01). These links have an end where two nodes lie on the same point, so which node the link ends at cannot be determined, and they were not imported.

entries.complaint: "Open a DXF file that this page exported as a new project": "as a new project" can attach to "exported" or to "Open".
readings: open the file, as a new project
the page exported the file as a new project
entries.resolution: English rewritten as proposed (orchestrator, 2026-11-01). Create a new project from a DXF file that this page exported. The blocks and polylines on layers beginning C-WATR-MODL- are read with their attributes. Anything else in the drawing is listed and not read.
